document:2:532:0.text:
This candy is made with <style="highlight">sweet fruit</style> and <style="highlight">goat milk</style>. First, slowly melt the <style="highlight">sweet fruit</style> over hot water until it becomes syrupy. Then add warm <style="highlight">goat milk</style> a little at a time, stirring until the mixture thickens.
The result is a glossy, sweet treat that helps you relax and feel better.

此糖果以<style="highlight">“蜜糖果”</style>与<style="highlight">“羊奶”</style>为核心。先将<style="highlight">蜜糖果</style>隔水缓缓加热至拉丝状，再分次调入温热的<style="highlight">羊奶</style>，耐心搅拌至凝稠。
